title: Joint MDPs and Reinforcement Learning in Coupled-Dynamics Environments
abstract: arXiv:2603.06946v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many distributional quantities in reinforcement learning are intrinsically joint across actions, including distributions of gaps and probabilities of superiority. However, the classical Markov decision process (MDP) formalism specifies only marginal laws and leaves the joint law of counterfactual one-step outcomes across multiple possible actions at a state unspecified. We study coupled-dynamics environments with a multi-action generative interface which can sample counterfactual one-step outcomes for multiple actions under shared exogenous randomness. We propose joint MDPs (JMDPs) as a formalism for such environments by augmenting an MDP with a multi-action sample transition model which specifies a coupling of one-step counterfactual outcomes, while preserving standard MDP interaction as marginal observations. translated_title: 耦合动态环境中的联合马尔可夫决策过程与强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习中的许多分布量在本质上是跨动作联合的，包括间隙分布和优势概率等。然而，经典马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）形式化仅指定边际规律，未指定在某一状态下多个可能动作的反事实一步结果的联合规律。我们研究了具有多动作生成接口的耦合动态环境，该接口可以在共享外生随机性下为多个动作采样反事实一步结果。我们提出联合马尔可夫决策过程（JMDPs）作为此类环境的形式化框架，通过用多动作样本转移模型增强MDP，该模型指定了一步反事实结果的耦合，同时保留标准MDP交互作为边际观测。我们采用并形式化了一步耦合机制，其中跨动作的依赖性仅限于即时反事实输出。
tldr: 本文提出联合马尔可夫决策过程（JMDPs）框架，通过多动作样本转移模型耦合一步反事实结果，解决了经典MDP在跨动作联合分布上的缺失，并适用于耦合动态环境。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Joint MDPs (JMDPs) to couple one-step counterfactual outcomes via a multi-action sample transition model, addressing the gap in classical MDPs for joint distributions across actions in coupled-dynamics environments.
